facts.fact: 春分黎明：Angelica 把玩黑曜石匕首（ desperation 魔法+Mount Netsai/前 Deia 锻炉所造）；Cosima 睡在身旁。
facts.anchor: Angelica turned her obsidian dagger over in her hands

facts.fact: 剧痛袭来——Yvri 远程示警「Something is wrong」；她断定「It's another attack. Bigger」；小提琴留在房里（不肯退回 conduit）。
全宅望天：一只巨大不眨之眼悬空（白眼球+淡晶环虹膜）；Cosima 爆粗「Thana’s piss-stained grave」。
facts.anchor: A large, unblinking eye hung above them

facts.fact: Julian 被卫兵放进（背长弓、eyeshine 泛绿——Nikolas 曾说「They used to be darker」）：「It didn't start out as an eye. There was a Conjuration circle burned into the sun.」
facts.anchor: There was a Conjuration circle burned into the sun.

facts.fact: 金泪坠落：眼睑沿涌出液光凝成 aureate tear——半空裂成数十小泪、如血点猩红洒向全城；一滴砸中 Mardova 草坪。
facts.anchor: It split apart midair, forming dozens of smaller tears

facts.fact: 翼战士登场：金 ichor 池中站出白发尖耳的 Solarian（胸口烙金灰符号、生真翼非 Lumin 光翼）——「On behalf of Almighty Lord Phos...we come to beget light to these dark lands」+双头斧。
facts.anchor: we come to beget light to these dark lands.

facts.fact: 空战：战士抓起 Angelica 升空越过 Gravespire 顶——「Almighty Phos has entrusted me to deliver your fate」；Julian 一箭中其左肩（蚊叮级）；她第三眼 squint open 喷酸火挣脱、坠落中唱三音开门落上 Yvri 背。
终结：Yvri 蛇形拧身一口把战士咬成两半（尸块落街）；Yvri 吐一句「Sending minions with only a fraction of his strength. Pathetic.」——全城至少还有十二个翼战士，部分 Solarians 降到 Deia 圣殿。
facts.anchor: Sending minions with only a fraction of his strength.

facts.fact: Adela 亲征：元素环绕身（火水土风腰带交叉）——吻额「Be safe, Angel. All of you.」；Angelica 透露「Some are at the basilica. They may be trying to destroy the portal」。
离别：Cosima/Eiko 请战被拒（护家）；Cosima 按颈硬吻——「more teeth than lip, more pain than pleasure, more prayer than curse」；Eiko 拥抱「Don’t die. You can't」——呼应 Azuna 乡野那句「I don't want to lose anyone else」。
